comparison.title: Why enterprises choose DXBiz tailored software over boxed SaaS?
comparison.subtitle: Eliminate rigid out-of-the-box workflows and escalating per-user subscription fees with DXBiz tailored solutions.

rows.title: Workflow Alignment
rows.saas: Rigid out-of-the-box features. Your company is forced to adapt to the software. 50% unused bloated features while custom logic cannot be modified.
rows.dxbiz: Engineered around your actual workflows. Assemble the exact modules you need with custom approval flows, forms, and executive dashboards.

rows.title: Scalability & Evolution
rows.saas: Dependent entirely on vendor's generic product roadmap. Difficult to build custom integrations or proprietary features.
rows.dxbiz: Seamlessly build new modules, customize business rules, and connect new systems without disrupting current operational continuity.

rows.title: Cost Model as Headcount Grows
rows.saas: Recurring subscription per user seat. Costs escalate dramatically every month as your company headcount scales up.
rows.dxbiz: Unlimited employee user accounts. Transparent one-time investment with zero hidden licensing traps.

rows.title: Embedded AI Assistant
rows.saas: None or generic chatbots disconnected from core ledger records, purchase orders, and internal operational workflows.
rows.dxbiz: AI Agent natively embedded: automated e-invoice OCR parsing, smart ledger matching, and proactive overdue alerts.

rows.title: Centralized Data & Integration
rows.saas: Walled-garden ecosystem, awkward data extraction, causing siloed operational software sprawl between departments.
rows.dxbiz: Unified operational database with two-way open API integration with MISA Accounting, E-Invoices, VietQR Banking, and Zalo OA.
